  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. items.explanation: 古代 is the setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代.
items.corrected: 古代的时候 → 在古代

items.explanation: 神农 appears for the first time here, so briefly introduce him with an identifying noun phrase rather than only using a pronoun or name.
This changes a story fact: the story refers to kinds of plants, so use 种 rather than 个.
It would be more natural to say 了解 when talking about whether plants are good for the body.
你 refers to the listener, but this sentence means people in general. Use 人 here.
神农 is already clear from the previous clause, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.
了 cannot go between 去 and 吃. Use the verb phrase 去吃 without 了 in the middle.
It would be more natural to keep 吃 here: 去吃每种植物 is the natural verb phrase.
你 refers to the listener, but the sentence means people in general. Use 人 here.
聊 takes its topic directly here, so delete 到.
会 describes a future or habitual action, so do not use sentence-final 了 here.
